entries.title: Sync upstream 30.2.0: per-listing currency, no more euros on kroner
entries.text:
• Kroner everywhere: the dashboard's median price and price per m² now show in kroner for Danish listings, not euros.
  • Translation: the "Translate to English" button works again after Google blocked the server. Searches now translate at a gentle pace, at most 20 new descriptions per run, and pause for 30 minutes after a refusal.
  • Phone: the side menu folds away after you pick a page, so the map is usable on a small screen.
  • Upstream: brings in Fredy 30.2.0.

entries.title: Score: energy label as a Home metric
entries.text:
The listing score now counts the energy label: A and B score full marks, F and G none. Change the targets per job in the Score card.

entries.title: What's new in two parts (Fredy + Fredy DK), and a release workflow
entries.text: What's new now has a Fredy DK part, so you'll hear about the Danish features here, next to upstream's news.

entries.title: Fredy DK: Fredy speaks Danish property
entries.text:
This fork of Fredy adds Denmark. Four new providers: Boligsiden, BoligPortal, Lejebolig and Danica Ejendomme. Paste a search URL from any of them like you would for any other portal.

Prices are shown in kroner, and the financing page speaks kroner and carries a Danish disclaimer when you are in Denmark mode.

entries.title: Danish map layers
entries.text:
The map has a Denmark box with layers built on Danish data:
  • Tax by kommune
  • Schools, with a score range and colours by type
  • Supermarkets, with the chains' logos
  • Jobs within reach
  • Broadband speeds by address

entries.title: Renting in Denmark
entries.text:
Listings now carry the Danish rental terms (deposit, prepaid rent and the like) on the listing detail card, and a rental can be marked available now.

New filter: move-in date. The map has the overview's filters too.

entries.title: Buying in Denmark
entries.text:
Danish sales get their own sale card with the monthly costs, time on market, building facts and links.

Also new for buyers:
  • An earlier sales table for the same address
  • A Danish financing model: funding stack, bidrag, kurs, costs and rentefradrag, used wherever Fredy judges affordability
  • New filters: ejerudgift, energy label, relisted and price reduced
  • The price per m2 in the at-a-glance box
